vault.welcome:
# Welcome to your vault

This folder is the Obsidian vault of the box. It is also readable:

- by **Hermes**, in `/opt/data/coffre`: ask it to summarize or tidy your notes;
- by **n8n**, in `/coffre`: a workflow can write a report there every evening.

On the machine hosting the box, these are plain Markdown files of the `coffre` folder.
